free_tier.stated: not stated: https://aws.amazon.com/fargate/pricing/ prints no free tier and no credit for Fargate; it includes 20 GB of ephemeral storage for every task and pod by default
free_tier.notes: the USD 100 figure matches the AWS account-wide credit on https://aws.amazon.com/free/: a new AWS Free Tier account gets $100 in credits immediately, and up to $200 over 6 months on the Free plan

per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

interface_detail: Access interface not documented in published terms.

limits.value: per second with a 1-minute minimum on Linux and 5 minutes on Windows; the container image pull is billed
Fargate has no persistent disk beyond the ephemeral task storage; a stopped task loses it

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented.

identity_cost.detail: an AWS account: an email address, or an existing Google, Apple, GitHub or Amazon login, quoted 'Create an account with a sign-in method you already have, such as Google or GitHub.' and 'Enter your email or choose a login such as Google, Apple, GitHub, or Amazon.'; no card for most new customers, quoted "No. A payment method isn't required to sign up for most new customers." and 'No credit card required to start for most new customers.', while the advanced sign-up states "You can't proceed with the sign-up process until you add a valid payment method."; a phone number in the advanced sign-up, quoted 'This number is used for identity verification purposes and to confirm the ownership of your account. You must be able to receive calls and SMS messages at this phone number.'; no country limit on signup, quoted 'The AWS Free Tier is available to all new customers.', and the credits and account plan selections are 'not available in the China (ZHY) and China (BJS) regions' and not in AWS GovCloud (US)

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded in the source passes
confidence_note: the Fargate pricing page states per-second billing with a 1-minute minimum (5 minutes for Windows) from the start of the image download, and prints no free tier or credit

evidence.proved: listed in the peli-cloud corpus card at commit f6a71ab0; the card is the source, not the vendor page

'Pricing is calculated per second with a 1-minute minimum. Duration is calculated from the time you start to download your container image' and 'For Windows containers, billing is calculated per second with a 5-minute minimum', quoted
the page includes 20 GB of ephemeral storage per task or pod and prints no free tier or credit for Fargate compute
evidence.quote: 20 GB of ephemeral storage is available for all Fargate Tasks and Pods by default—you only pay for any additional storage that you configure.

evidence.proved: a new AWS Free Tier account receives USD 100 of credit at creation; the credit is AWS-wide, not a Fargate allowance
evidence.quote: When you create a new AWS Free Tier account, you get $100 in credits immediately.

evidence.proved: Fargate bills per second with a 1-minute minimum
evidence.quote: Pricing is calculated per second with a 1-minute minimum.

evidence.proved: per-second billing with a 1-minute minimum, counted from the image pull
evidence.quote: Pricing is calculated per second with a 1-minute minimum. Duration is calculated from the time you start to download your container image (Docker pull) until the task terminates, rounded up to the nearest second.

evidence.proved: no payment method is required for most new customers, and one can be requested as identity verification
evidence.quote: No. A payment method isn't required to sign up for most new customers. In some cases, we may request additional information, such as a payment method, to verify your identity.

evidence.quote: Fast sign up: Create an account with a sign-in method you already have, such as Google or GitHub. No credit card required to start for most new customers.

evidence.proved: the advanced sign-up requires a phone number that receives calls and SMS, for identity verification

evidence.proved: no country is excluded from signing up
evidence.quote: The AWS Free Tier is available to all new customers. All customers are welcome to sign up online.

extras.keep_rate_basis: billed for uptime (no suspension feature published)

session_cap.note: a task runs until it exits or is stopped; the billed floor is 1 minute, not a reap
